rulings.chains: a direct chain is an iter() call, std::iter::range(a, b) or a C14b text source (chars(), split(literal)), any number of adapters (skip, take, map, filter, filter_map, flat_map, enumerate, chain, rev) and one consumer: a C17d terminal, next() or a for loop after at least one adapter, or fold, reduce, find, any, all; expanded into charged instructions over the existing IterNext, CallValue, Binary, Branch and List ops with adapter state in slots
rulings.function_values: a function value operand is a literal closure, a fn item or tuple constructor, or a local bound once to one; its parameter count must equal what the call passes (captures included), checked when every function is lowered, or the program is refused and runs on stock (C17d arity ruling); any other operand stays refused
rulings.function_copy: stock moves a function value passed to an adapter or consumer (Function: FromValue takes it); fresh function values are copies, so a later use succeeds (Intentional-function-copy, pre-ruled)
rulings.laziness: adapter operands convert in source order when each adapter is reached (chain converts its argument with protocol_into_iter then); closures run per element in pipeline order, so map runs on elements skip discards; take stops without pulling; find/any/all stop at their first decisive element; reduce calls nothing for one element
rulings.rev: rev reads the source back to front by offset; directly on any source (Object, RangeFrom and text sources raise the stock missing-method error), and over map/filter/filter_map of a Vec, Tuple, Some or bounded range literal or std::iter::range, and over skip/take of a Vec or Tuple literal; anything else stays refused
rulings.iterators: iterator-valued chain arguments stay refused as passed iterators; a stored, passed or returned chain keeps its earlier refusal; an iterator a flat_map closure returns at run time is iterated as protocol_into_iter does
rulings.any: any on a bare source stays the C12 small form, except on chars() or an adapted split, which C12 refuses
rulings.frames: an error inside a function value a chain calls carries stock's call chain; stock splits it into one site per nested VM execution, fresh reports it as the origin with its callers (C11 Retained-frame (callback) precedent)
rulings.fuel: fuel is charged per expanded instruction and per called function; rows that exhaust stock fuel halt in fresh with the stock class (C14b Retained-fuel precedent)
rulings.warnings: stock LetPatternMightPanic for a destructuring closure parameter; the fresh frontend does not report it (O1 precedent)
rulings.wrong_receiver: fresh names the missing method (existing D1 intentional diagnostic), also for rev on a source without one
